zh: a medical examination to assess the condition of a person’s body or mind
an assessment of the condition of something
en: a medical examination to assess the condition of a person’s body or mind
ex: A routine health check revealed that his blood pressure was high.
例行健康检查显示他的血压高。

en: a private club where people go to do physical exercise in order to stay or become healthy and fit

zh: 健身会馆，休闲健身中心（提供特定饮食、身体锻炼等短期休养服务）
en: a place where people can stay for short periods of time in order to try to improve their health by eating special food, doing physical exercise, etc.
food that does not contain any artificial substances and is therefore thought to be good for your health
ex: a health food store/shop
保健食品商店/商店

en: HMO
a public service providing medical care
ex: a shortage of labour in the health service
公共医疗卫生系统中人员的缺乏

zh: 健身会馆，休闲健身中心（提供特定饮食、身体锻炼等短期休养服务）
en: a place where people can relax and receive health and beauty treatments, with, for example, steam baths and exercise equipment
ex: a superb health spa, which includes sauna, Turkish bath and fitness rooms
内设桑拿浴室、土耳其浴室和健身房的第一流的休闲健身中心

zh: 医疗旅游（出国接受医疗服务）
en: the practice of travelling abroad in order to have medical treatment
(in the UK) a trained nurse whose job is to visit people in their homes, for example new parents, and give them advice on some areas of medical care
ex: The baby's weight is monitored by the health visitor.
婴儿的体重由家访护士跟踪记录。

en: the service of providing medical care
ex: the costs of healthcare for the elderly
老年人的医疗费用

en: good for your health
in a way that is good for your health

zh: in a healthy way; in a way that avoids somebody/something becoming ill
en: in a healthy way; in a way that avoids somebody/something becoming ill
ex: A good gardener knows how to keep things growing healthily.
一个好的园丁知道如何保持身体健康。

zh: the quality of being good for your health
the quality of being normal and sensible
en: the quality of having good health and not being likely to become ill
ex: Basic care of your plants will promote healthiness.
植物的基本护理将促进健康。

en: having good health and not likely to become ill
ex: a healthy child/baby/adult
健康的孩子/婴儿/成人

en: an untidy pile of something
ex: The building was reduced to a heap of rubble.
大楼变成了一堆废墟。
